title: Sabine Wren
subtitle: Rebel
description: Sabine Wren began life on Mandalore as a member of Clan Wren. After joining the Imperial Academy, the independent-by-nature Sabine defected, instead opting to take up with Hera Syndulla and Kanan Jarrus as a member of the Ghost crew. Following the disappearance of Ezra Bridger, Sabine accompanied Ahsoka Tano in her search for Grand Admiral Thrawn and the missing Bridger.
